verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־ שׁוּשַׁ֣ן עֵד֑וּת מִכְתָּ֖ם לְדָוִ֣ד לְלַמֵּֽד׃ בְּהַצּוֹת֨וֹ׀ אֶ֥ת אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרַיִם֮ וְאֶת־ אֲרַ֪ם צ֫וֹבָ֥ה וַיָּ֤שָׁב יוֹאָ֗ב וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־ אֱד֣וֹם בְּגֵיא־ מֶ֑לַח שְׁנֵ֖ים עָשָׂ֣ר אָֽלֶף׃ אֱ֭לֹהִים זְנַחְתָּ֣נוּ פְרַצְתָּ֑נוּ אָ֝נַ֗פְתָּ תְּשׁ֣וֹבֵ֥ב לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘al- šū·šan ‘ê·ḏūṯ miḵ·tām lə·ḏā·wiḏ lə·lam·mêḏ bə·haṣ·ṣō·w·ṯōw ’eṯ ’ă·ram na·hă·ra·yim wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ram ṣō·w·ḇāh way·yā·šāḇ yō·w·’āḇ way·yaḵ ’eṯ- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm bə·ḡê- me·laḥ šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ’ā·lep̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm zə·naḥ·tā·nū p̄ə·raṣ·tā·nū ’ā·nap̄·tā tə·šō·w·ḇêḇ lā·nū
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of The Lily of the Covenant A Miktam of David for instruction When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 . . . . . . Edomites in the Valley of Salt You have rejected us O God You have broken us You have been angry restore us
verses.literalPt: Ó DEUS, tu nos rejeitaste, tu nos espalhaste, tu te indignaste; oh, volta-te para nós.

verses.original: הִרְעַ֣שְׁתָּה אֶ֣רֶץ פְּצַמְתָּ֑הּ רְפָ֖ה שְׁבָרֶ֣יהָ כִי־ מָֽטָה׃
verses.transliteration: hir·‘aš·tāh ’e·reṣ pə·ṣam·tāh rə·p̄āh šə·ḇā·re·hā ḵî- mā·ṭāh
verses.literal: You have shaken the land and torn it open Heal its fractures for it is quaking
verses.literalPt: Abalaste a terra, e a fendeste; sara as suas fendas, pois ela treme.

verses.original: הִרְאִ֣יתָה עַמְּךָ֣ קָשָׁ֑ה הִ֝שְׁקִיתָ֗נוּ יַ֣יִן תַּרְעֵלָֽה׃
verses.literal: You have shown Your people hardship we are staggered from the wine You made us drink
verses.literalPt: Fizeste ver ao teu povo coisas árduas; fizeste-nos beber o vinho do atordoamento.

verses.original: נָ֘תַ֤תָּה לִּירֵאֶ֣יךָ נֵּ֭ס לְהִתְנוֹסֵ֑ס מִ֝פְּנֵ֗י קֹ֣שֶׁט סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯat·tāh lî·rê·’e·ḵā nês lə·hiṯ·nō·w·sês mip·pə·nê qō·šeṭ se·lāh
verses.literal: You have raised a banner for those who fear You that they may flee . . . the bow Selah
verses.literalPt: Deste um estandarte aos que te temem, para o arvorarem no alto, por causa da verdade. (Selá.)

verses.original: לְ֭מַעַן יֵחָלְצ֣וּן יְדִידֶ֑יךָ הוֹשִׁ֖יעָה יְמִֽינְךָ֣ וַעֲנֵנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yê·ḥā·lə·ṣūn yə·ḏî·ḏe·ḵā hō·wō·šî·‘āh yə·mî·nə·ḵā wa·ʿă·nē·nū
verses.literal: Respond and save us with Your right hand that Your beloved may be delivered
verses.literalPt: Para que os teus amados sejam livres, salva-nos com a tua destra, e ouve-nos;

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ דִּבֶּ֥ר בְּקָדְשׁ֗וֹ אֶ֫עְלֹ֥זָה אֲחַלְּקָ֥ה שְׁכֶ֑ם וְעֵ֖מֶק סֻכּ֣וֹת אֲמַדֵּֽד׃
verses.literal: God has spoken from His sanctuary I will triumph I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth
verses.literalPt: Deus falou na sua santidade; eu me regozijarei, repartirei a Siquém e medirei o vale de Sucote.

verses.original: לִ֤י גִלְעָ֨ד׀ וְלִ֬י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה וְ֭אֶפְרַיִם מָע֣וֹז רֹאשִׁ֑י יְ֝הוּדָ֗ה מְחֹֽקְקִי׃
verses.transliteration: lî ḡil·‘āḏ wə·lî mə·naš·šeh wə·’ep̄·ra·yim mā·‘ō·wz rō·šî yə·hū·ḏāh mə·ḥō·qə·qî
verses.literal: Gilead is Mine and Manasseh is Mine Ephraim is My helmet . . . Judah is My scepter
verses.literalPt: Meu é Gileade, e meu é Manassés; Efraim é a força da minha cabeça; Judá é o meu legislador.

verses.original: מוֹאָ֤ב׀ סִ֬יר רַחְצִ֗י עַל־ אֱ֭דוֹם אַשְׁלִ֣יךְ נַעֲלִ֑י עָ֝לַ֗י פְּלֶ֣שֶׁת הִתְרֹעָֽעִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mō·w·’āḇ sîr raḥ·ṣî ‘al- ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ’aš·lîḵ na·‘ă·lî ‘ā·lay pə·le·šeṯ hiṯ·rō·‘ā·‘î
verses.literal: Moab is My washbasin . . . upon Edom I toss My sandal over Philistia I shout in triumph
verses.literalPt: Moabe é a minha bacia de lavar; sobre Edom lançarei o meu sapato; alegra-te, ó Filístia, por minha causa.

verses.original: מִ֣י יֹ֭בִלֵנִי עִ֣יר מָצ֑וֹר מִ֖י נָחַ֣נִי עַד־ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.literal: Who will bring me to the fortified city Who will lead me to Edom
verses.literalPt: Quem me conduzirá à cidade forte? Quem me guiará até Edom?

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־ אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים זְנַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְֽלֹא־ תֵצֵ֥א אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.literal: Have You not . . . rejected us O God Will You no longer march out O God with our armies
verses.literalPt: Não serás tu, ó Deus, que nos tinhas rejeitado? tu, ó Deus, que não saíste com os nossos exércitos?

verses.original: הָֽבָה־ לָּ֣נוּ עֶזְרָ֣ת מִצָּ֑ר וְ֝שָׁ֗וְא תְּשׁוּעַ֥ת אָדָם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇāh- lā·nū ‘ez·rāṯ miṣ·ṣār wə·šāw tə·šū·‘aṯ ʾå̄·ḏå̄m
verses.literal: Give us aid against the enemy for the help of man is worthless
verses.literalPt: Dá-nos auxílio na angústia, porque vão é o socorro do homem.

verses.original: בֵּֽאלֹהִ֥ים נַעֲשֶׂה־ חָ֑יִל וְ֝ה֗וּא יָב֥וּס צָרֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bê·lō·hîm na·‘ă·śeh- ḥā·yil wə·hū yā·ḇūs ṣā·rê·nū
verses.literal: With God we will perform with valor and He will trample our enemies
verses.literalPt: Em Deus faremos proezas; porque ele é que pisará os nossos inimigos.
